`chrome-devtools-mcp-1.6.0.json` contains the public tool catalog emitted by
Chrome DevTools MCP 1.6.0, with the broker's structured-content and interop flags.
It is used to check the pinned schema dialect and context budgets without
starting a worker. The response envelope was removed; tool definitions are
unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/tree/chrome-devtools-mcp-v1.6.0
